items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I played with Buck and the people in our group were Buck, Pee Wee... I remember that I was playing with the Pollack band... the call was from Pee Wee Russell

ctx.x: Really, when you called the lineup on that band, there'd be few bands of anybody's band that you could call a lineup like that. I don't think the Goodman band would be any finer, would it?

Well, of course, Benny was in another type of music and we were -- but it was dance music, of course. Our band was not -- Noble's band was not a jazz band in any sense, excepting that he allowed me to play and he allowed Pee Wee to play and so --
